turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
Hello, I can help with that. To find your order, please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1007) and the email address you used when you placed the order.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.

Thank you, Claire. I found order SC-3744 (Last Lantern, 40x50 cm, 1350 RON, delivered 9 November 2026). Because the refund amount is large, I cannot approve this return myself. I have passed your request to a colleague, who will take over and decide on the return and refund with you here in this chat.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Verified customer Claire Fontaine (claire.fontaine@example.com) wants to return order SC-3744 (Last Lantern, limited, 40x50 cm, 1350 RON, delivered 2026-11-09) because she ordered the wrong size, and wants a refund. Return policy check: decision not allowed, reason large_refund, so staff must decide. No return request was filed.
